title: Keyed bare credential next to a public identifier of the same shape in one input
summary: One input holds a bare key under its provider-named variable and, on another line, a public identifier with the same length and alphabet (a UUID request id, a trace-id, a commit name). Only the key is expected to be reported.
rationale: A recogniser that keys on shape alone would report both values or neither. The two values are indistinguishable by shape, so the expectation records that the keyed one is a credential and the identifier is not, and the span covers the key only. This guards partial attribution within a single input.

expectation.rationale: The key is expected to be reported because it sits under its provider-named variable (the family contracts record context as the recognition signal for these unprefixed shapes); the identifier on the other line is a public identifier. The context rule is a project decision, not a provider statement.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
